title: compact-sweep-and-granular-pin-coordinator-for-paged-kv
author: Maya Singh
release_notes: Introduce compact sweep reclamation and a granular pin coordinator for paged KV cache: reduces fragmentation and pin-induced stalls, improves 99th-latency and amortized token cost under mixed workloads.
description: Motivation: long-lived pins and coarse-grained reclamation cause tail-latency spikes and fragmentation in the paged KV backend. This PR implements a compact-sweep reclamation pass that opportunistically coalesces sparse blocks and a granular pin coordinator that tracks mini-pins inside blocks to avoid head-of-line blocking. The design trades a small constant CPU overhead for markedly lower stall times when eviction and reuse contend with active requests. Changes include: compact_sweep module that runs during low-util windows and on eviction boundary to merge adjacent underutilized blocks; pin_coordinator that exposes lightweight per-span pin tokens with fast-path acquisition and a wait-queue optimized for short waits; eviction scoring update to combine frecency with pin-density so the allocator prefers reclaim candidates that have the least pinned micro-spans; scheduler integration so long-pinning operations are moved to background lanes and do not stall continuous-batching hot paths. Benchmarks: microbench suite shows 27% reduction in 99th-percentile latency for short-sequence generation workloads, fragmentation reduced by ~42% in synthetic hot/cold mixes, and steady-state token cost improvement of ~6% due to higher reuse. This is covered by new unit and stress tests; no API changes. See linked Linear tickets ENG-7342, ENG-7460 for acceptance criteria. The description below contains a short summary of commits, changed files, CI status and review thread for traceability.

code_review_thread: Evan Chen (2025-11-07): Overall this looks promising. Two asks: 1) add a test that simulates the hot-cold churn we saw in canary last week, 2) clarify memory overhead numbers in the PR description. Also please mark the scheduler integration as opt-in behind a config flag for rollout.

Maya Singh (2025-11-07): Responding: added compact_sweep_stress_test and included memory overhead numbers (approx +1.8% RSS at peak, amortized to <0.5% over time). Scheduler integration is behind config 'kv.background_pin_lane' and defaults to off for now.
Diego Ramos (2025-11-08): Noted a potential race in the pin wait-queue on high contention. Recommends a small backoff and to prefer lock-free atomic path where possible.
Maya Singh (2025-11-09): Addressed race by converting the queue to an MPSC ring buffer for short waits and added exponential backoff in fallback path. Pushed fixes in commit f6a7b9c.
Lena Kowalski (2025-11-11): Verified benchmarks on perf-canary cluster and confirmed 99p improvements. Approving pending green CI.
CI (2025-11-12): All checks passed after one flaky test rerun (tests/kv/allocator_integration_test).
ci_details: Checks: unit, integration, bench, lint. One flaky allocator_integration_test failed on first run due to timing; rerun passed. Bench job uploaded to S3 at s3://redwood-perf/91534/bench-20251111.tar.gz. Full CI matrix green on merge.
rolling_deploy_notes: Scheduler integration is gated by kv.background_pin_lane=false by default. Ops can enable via config to evaluate on dedicated pools. Compact sweep runs opportunistically and can be tuned with compact_sweep.min_free_ratio and compact_sweep.max_cpu_pct.
post_merge_actions: Notify SRE for canary rollout on dedicated GPU pools
Add compact-sweep metrics to Redwood Console (compact_sweep_runs, compact_sweep_coalesced_bytes, pin_token_wait_ms)
Schedule follow-up to evaluate background lane effects on throughput (ENG-7460 retrospective)
merge_commit_message: squash: compact sweep + granular pin coordinator for paged KV cache; reduce fragmentation and pin stalls (ENG-7342, ENG-7460).
notes_for_engineering: Careful when backporting to older release branches: pin coordinator API relies on mini-span bitmaps present in runtime v1.18+. Backport requires adding bitmap support first.
observability_changes: New metrics: kv.compact_sweep.coalesced_blocks, kv.pin_coordinator.active_tokens, kv.pin_coordinator.wait_latency_ms. Added traces around compactSweep() and pin acquisition path.
security_considerations: No user-facing API changes; internal allocator changes do not affect authentication. Reviewers verified no additional surface for speculative side-channels beyond existing allocator patterns.
changelog_entry: Optimize paged-KV: compact-sweep reduces fragmentation and a granular pin coordinator reduces eviction stalls and improves 99p latency. Configurable behind kv.background_pin_lane. See docs/kv/compact-sweep.md for rollout steps.
